provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation: The mechanism looks the same under every D4 transform. The program crops the bounding box of the frame colour (palette[2]) and keeps the frame border. It clears the interior to the background colour (palette[0]). It then finds the bounding box of interior cells that are neither background nor frame colour. That box is the stamped 2x2 quadrant block. The four logical colours are read from the top-left cell of each quadrant, at offsets of half the block height and width. This works for any stamp size and still works if two quadrant colours happen to be equal. Each colour is then expanded to fill its half-by-half region of the interior. A rotation or reflection of the scene rotates or reflects the 2x2 pattern in the same way, so reading the pattern in visible coordinates is already correct. The only colour constants are palette[0] and palette[2], which are specialised directly. Nothing is unpermuted or inverse-rotated.
draft_notes.limitations: The program assumes the quadrant colours never equal background colour 0. The constructor excludes only colour 2 explicitly; common.random_colors is assumed to exclude 0 as well. If a quadrant colour could be 0, the block extent would be ambiguous: it is placed at a random offset, so a background-coloured quadrant could not be located. In that case the constructor should be reviewed by the host. The program also assumes a single frame-coloured rectangle and an even-sized interior and block, which the generator guarantees (sizes are 2*base and 2*k). For odd interiors the extra row or column goes to the bottom or right half. No fixture contradictions were found. No tests were run.
draft_notes.host_review: The solver assigned inner=out[1:-1,1:-1], then cleared that same output slice. Because inner was a NumPy view, the sampled quadrant colours became background before extraction. Copy the inner array before clearing; this is an execution bug, not a change to the puzzle rule.
draft_notes.host_sampler_revision: Constructor unchanged. Direct visible-coordinate crop and quadrant expansion otherwise unchanged. All fixture variants and generated colours/sizes now exact.
